front.title: Intra-handshake Attestation Considered Harmful (CVE-2026-33697 of CVSS 7.5)

abstract.t: The draft aims to provide technical details of CVE-2026-33697 and EUVD-2026-16488 (https://euvd.enisa.europa.eu/enisa/EUVD-2026-16488), which is substantial technical evidence of how *intra*-handshake attestation fails in practice, even _without phyical access_. Moreover, since continuous attestation is required, *intra*-handshake attestation adds *unnecessary complexity*. The results are backed by the research [Intra-handshake.fail] and the ProVerif artifacts [Intra-handshake.fail-repo] under Apache-2.0 license for reproducibility, and have been acknowledged by the relevant stakeholders.
